lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition La4Mg2Ti8O20 (LaMgTi4O10) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-42d (No. 122), with 34 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral Mg centers coordinated by four O neighbors, and octahedral Ti centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while La centers show nine geometric neighbors. The oxygen environments are two-coordinate, with one Mg and one Ti neighbor each. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 34 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Mg tetrahedra and Ti octahedra, as well as edge-sharing between Ti octahedra.
